Interface IMapping

All Superinterfaces:
Cloneable, ICDKObject, IChemObject
All Known Implementing Classes:
DebugMapping, Mapping, Mapping
public interface IMapping extends IChemObject
Represents a mapping of two atoms.
Author:
kaihartmann
Created on:
2006-02-15
